description: Defines the StaticRangeMap template class used for mapping address ranges to entries, wrapping a StaticMap and providing retrieval methods for ranges based on address or index.

classes.name: StaticRangeMap
classes.description: A template class for mapping address ranges to entries, providing range retrieval functionalities.

methods.name: RetrieveRange
methods.description: Locates the range encompassing the supplied address.

methods.name: RetrieveNearestRange
methods.description: Locates the range encompassing the supplied address or the nearest lower range.

methods.name: RetrieveRangeAtIndex
methods.description: Retrieves the range at a specified index.

methods.name: GetCount
methods.description: Returns the number of ranges stored.
